title: Goldfinch V1 overview
notes: First-party documentation establishing Goldfinch as a decentralized credit protocol using USDC-funded borrower pools, Senior Pool liquidity and off-chain collateralized credit exposure.

title: GIP-87 maintenance mode and Goldfinch Prime wind-down
notes: Official governance thread describing the maintenance-mode plan and containing the July 7 project update that Prime investors were fully redeemed, new deposits disabled and the Prime contract paused, while legacy V1 deals remained in repayment or recovery.

title: Goldfinch borrower-pool default process
notes: First-party documentation describing borrower-pool default handling and the interaction between smart-contract pool terms and off-chain legal agreements.
